verdict.rationale: CRA documents EFILE as a sanctioned system-to-system transmitter channel. Certified tax software goes through a CRA compatibility process, and enrolled electronic filers use an EFILE number and password to transmit returns, view transmission history, and maintain or renew their accounts; ReFILE covers amended T1 returns. The agency's own pages are said to publish the enrollment path. Missing for 10: quoted step-by-step enrollment and software-certification requirements; evidence of machine channels beyond T1 return filing (e.g., payroll/GST batch transmitters or API system accounts); independent or hands-on corroboration.
